item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (63)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 63

  • Frames shot within two seconds are compared, and the sharpest comes first
  • Softer frames can be marked reject, or moved to the Trash after you confirm
  • Birds, mammals, and other animals are named, and focus is read on the animal
